integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard ordered-code Singleton bound. The computational checker is supplementary and is not used to infer the general-\(q\) theorem.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to the ordered Hamming parameters \(n=2\), \(r=2\), and \(d=3\). The binary orbit statement concerns the natural affine ordered-metric isometry group only.
title: Complete equality classification in the smallest two-block ordered Hamming MDS problem
